title: 5th Girls und Panzer das Finale Film's Trailer Previews Story
content: Bandai Namco Filmworks posted the first full trailer, first key visual, and story for the fifth film in the six-part Girls und Panzer das Finale film series on Sunday. The fifth film is set after Ōarai Girls High School's win in the fierce semi-finals of the Winter Continuous Track Cup, and they head to the finals,…
author: ANN

title: Live-Action Strange: Junji Ito's Tales for Sleepless Nights Series Rearranges Episode Order
content: The staff had planned to air and stream the "Lovesickness" (Part 1)" episode as the second episode of the overall series, but it will premiere as the first episode now. The staff has not specified when the previously planned first episode, "The Mansion of Phantom Pain," will air and stream later.
author: ANN

title: Cyberpunk Edgerunners 2 Reveals Female Main Cast Member Taliya Yang, Fall 2026 Release Date
content: Studio TRIGGER has introduced its first CYBERPUNK EDGERUNNERS 2 female main cast member, Taliya Yang, as the fourth character ahead of the anime’s Fall 2026 release. Fans at the Annecy International Animation Film Festival had the chance to see a teaser earlier this week, while the main announcement is set for…

title: Though I am an Inept Villainess Anime's New Subtitled Video Unveils Rokudenashi's Ending Song
content: The staff for the television anime of Satsuki Nakamura 's Though I Am an Inept Villainess ( Futsutsuka na Akujo de wa Gozaimasu ga - Sūgū Chōso Torikae Den ) light novel series started streaming a pre-broadcast promotional video on Sunday.
author: ANN

title: Magilumiere Magical Girls Inc. Season 2 Streams 2nd Promo Video
content: The official website of Magilumiere Magical Girls Inc. , the television anime based on Sekka Iwata and Yū Aoki 's Magilumiere Co. Ltd. ( Kabushikigaisha Magilumiere ) manga, started streaming the second promotional video for the second season on Sunday.
author: ANN

title: Wistoria: Wand and Sword Anime Gets 3rd Season
content: The official website for the second television anime season based on Fujino Ōmori and Toshi Aoi 's Wistoria: Wand and Sword ( Tsue to Tsurugi no Wistoria ) manga announced in an teaser on Sunday that production on a third season has been green-lit.
author: ANN

title: Mission: Yozakura Family Season 2 Reveals Cour 2 Trailer, Continues in October 2026
content: Mission: Yozakura Family Season 2 anime revealed a trailer for its Cour 2, which is set to release in October 2026. Studio SILVER LINK returned to animate, with twelve episodes released in the first part. You can watch the teaser trailer below.
author: Anime Corner

title: Ace of the Diamond Act II Season 2 Continues with Seido vs Inashiro Match in October 2026
content: Ace of the Diamond Act II Season 2 revealed a new visual for its second cour, set to continue with the Seido vs Inashiro match in October 2026. Taking over from Madhouse is studio OLM, which is animating the sequel with Hideaki Oba as the director.
author: Anime Corner

title: Ace of Diamond Act II Second Season Anime's 2nd Part Unveils October Premiere, Theme Song Artists, Key Visual
content: The staff for Ace of Diamond Act II Second Season , the sequel to the 2019-2020 anime of Yūji Terajima 's Ace of Diamond Act II ( Daiya no A Act II ) manga, revealed the October premiere, theme song artists, and a key visual for the second cours (quarter of a year) of the series on Sunday.
author: ANN

title: Sword Art Online's Echoes of Aincrad Game Streams 2nd Story Trailer
content: Bandai Namco Entertainment America began streaming the second story trailer for Echoes of Aincrad , the new action RPG based on Reki Kawahara 's Sword Art Online franchise , on Friday. The game is set in the world of Aincrad, the setting of the original story's eponymous in-story virtual MMO Sword Art Online .
author: ANN
